The collection offers performable repetitions, falls, trills, and overblown techniques, supported by six microphone positions, an integrated effects suite, and Komplete Kontrol integration. entry.title: StereoGhost Releases PhaseKicker Kick-Bass Phase Alignment Plugin
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com | stereoghost.ch

StereoGhost has released PhaseKicker, an audio plugin designed to automatically adjust the phase relationship between a kick drum and bass track on every individual hit. Developed by Swiss duo Gregor and Joachim Budweiser, the tool aims to prevent low-frequency cancellation by rechecking and aligning the bass phase with each triggered kick.

PhaseKicker operates via sidechain input, requiring users to set a detection threshold and an optimization point within the waveform display. The plugin introduces processing latency and is intended for mixing rather than live tracking. It is available in VST3, AAX, and AU formats for Windows and macOS, alongside a Linux VST3 version, and is currently offered at an introductory rate of $35 until November 30, 2026.

Included effects comprise trance gates, filters, phasers, repeaters, spatial processors, comb filters, wavefolders, pitch shifters, and time benders. It is available in VST3, AU, and AAX formats, with an introductory price offered until December 3, 2026.

entry.title: AudioThing Releases Seconds Spectral Sound Design Effect Plugin
entry.content:
Links: kvraudio.com | audiothing.net

AudioThing, in collaboration with Hainbach, has released Seconds, a spectral sound design effect plugin designed for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Built around a bank of 48 analog-modeled bandpass filters tuned in whole-tone steps, the plugin allows users to cut up sounds, sequence spectra via MIDI, and perform spectral freeze and transfer between audio sources.

Additional features include 12 and 24 dB slopes with resonance control, per-band ring modulation, odd/even panning control, volume and panning modulation, input saturation, and sample rate reduction. It supports VST2, VST3, AU, AAX, and CLAP formats, and is available at an introductory price through December 31, 2026.
